notes.content:

notes.title: 1.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]

notes.title: 1.4.0 Patch Notes - Localization and Keybindings!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] NEW: Translated game text and subtitles to Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Spain & Latin America), and Turkish.
[*] NEW: Added keyboard remapping.
[*] NEW: Added additional options for how subtitles are displayed.
[*] NEW: Added option to adjust ambient SFX volume.
[*] BUGFIX: Colorblind UI icons would not update in some circumstances.
[*] BUGFIX: Tube would sometimes not be visible in [spoiler]portal levels[/spoiler].
[*] Other minor changes and bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] BUGFIX: Player could not complete level if undoing or resetting after the [spoiler]gate is unlocked at the end of the spider boss level[/spoiler].
[*] BUGFIX: Level would remain dark when returning from the [spoiler]combat simulator to the village[/spoiler].
[*] BUGFIX: Some in-game signs were not being rendered.
[*] BUGFIX: MVH characters would sometimes act broken causing some levels unable to be completed.
[*] BUGFIX: The exit button in the [spoiler]Old Labs[/spoiler] level select screen could not be activated when using a controller.
[*] Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable is now included on Steam. We were previously relying entirely on Steam to install the redistributable.
[*] Other minor changes and bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] BUGFIX: Ambient SFX would become distorted at lower SFX volumes.
[*] BUGFIX: The Tier IV [spoiler]"A Mysterious Princess"[/spoiler] levels could not be completed when entering via the [spoiler]green pipe in the Village[/spoiler].
    [*] We were not able to reproduce this bug so we are not certain that our fix was successful. Please let us know if you continue to have issues.
[*] BUGFIX: Incorrect colorblind symbols when a block is rotated from it's starting orientation.
[*] Other minor changes and bugfixes.
[/list]

notes.title: 1.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- BUGFIX: Player character would cover poll response screen in ultrawide resolutions.
- BUGFIX: Using undo while certain actions were resolving could leave the level in an invalid state.
- BUGFIX: Continuing after completing the game would result in broken controls.
- BUGFIX: Incorrect color blind symbols in final Tier 2 level.
- BUGFIX: "Time Not Solving" on tester profile would show a negative time.
-- This was due to total play time not being properly tracked when closing the game or switching save slots. This will be tracked correctly moving forward, affected players will receive the Temporally Inconsistent trait.
- CHANGE: Reduced volume on rewind SFX.
- CHANGE: Reduced volume of [spoilers omitted] sound effects.
- CHANGE: Tier 1, Level 3: Leaderboard now shows milliseconds.
- CHANGE: Modified logic for playing "correct"/"incorrect" SFX when placing blocks on goal tiles to be more understandable.
- Other minor changes and bugfixes.

notes.title: Live Q&A with Lab Rat Devs Gwen & Lucas
notes.content:
Lab Rat is a collaboration between 2 designers:

[b][url=twitter.com/diregoldfish]Gwen Frey[/url][/b] has worked in commercial game development for 12 years. She was a senior technical animator on BioShock Infinite, cofounded The Molasses Flood & developed roguelike The Flame in the Flood, and just recently shipped a primarily solo commercial puzzle game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/824570/Kine/]Kine[/url].

[url=twitter.com/leslodev][b]Lucas Le Slo[/b][/url] is a classic bedroom indie. He is renown for his [url=https://le-slo.itch.io/]experimental in-browser puzzle games[/url], which he developed in his free time after work. He frequents game jams and often releases his games for free online.

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304610/Lab_Rat/]Lab Rat[/url] [/b]is a tight collaboration between these two developers. A game with rich, experimental puzzle mechanics that features AAA quality production values. Join these two on Monday as they discuss how they worked together, what drives them, and what they hope to achieve with Lab Rat.

notes.title: Live Puzzle Dev Roundtable
notes.content:
This is a true meeting of minds!

[b][url=https://twitter.com/Draknek]Alan Hazelden[/url][/b] is famous in puzzle game circles. He directed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052990/A_Monsters_Expedition/]A Monster's Expedition[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/583270/Cosmic_Express/]Cosmic Express[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/316610/A_Good_Snowman_Is_Hard_To_Build/]A Good Snowman Is Hard To Build[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/290260/Sokobond/]Sokobond[/url]. Alan runs the largest Discord dedicated to puzzle game development, "[url=https://discord.gg/ygsh3Hxy]Thinky Puzzle Games[/url]", and publishes puzzle games under his studio Draknek.

[b][url=https://twitter.com/direGoldfish]Gwen Frey[/url][/b] is a veteran AAA and indie game developer with credits in Marvel Heroes online, Bioshock Infinite, and The Flame in the Flood. She was the creator of the charming narrative puzzler  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/824570/Kine/]Kine[/url], and she is currently directing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304610/Lab_Rat/]Lab Rat[/url], a hilarious satirical puzzle game set to launch later this year.

[b][url=https://twitter.com/mytoboggan]Corey Martin[/url] [/b]is beloved not only for his games, but also for sharing his Unity Game development tools. Corey's puzzle games are as challenging as they are charming. He is best known for the delightfully colorful [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/721390/Pipe_Push_Paradise/]Pipe Push Paradise[/url], the soothing puzzler [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/950140/Hiding_Spot/]Hiding Spot[/url], and his upcoming puzzle game [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1147890/Bonfire_Peaks/]Bonfire Peaks[/url].

Join these three studio directors for 2 hours as they discuss how their work, what they've learned from their recent launches, and what they are looking forward to in 2021!
